summary: Reviewed the changed memory ingress, outbox and recall paths. Unconfirmed operation status stays distinct from a successful extraction. A timed-out verification records the last bounded backend error without initiating a new write. The deletion worker retains the bank binding, current scope check, delete grant and pre-dispatch authorization, and only deletes the immutable operation document after a terminal upstream result. Unknown and in-progress results still defer deletion. The multi-project summary is computed only from existing authorized recall outcomes and includes no new fact or project identifier. Provenance validation retains its allowlist and derives the writer from the authenticated principal.

tests.evidence: 12 tests including expired unreadable status, single send, and document deletion after terminal cancellation.
42 passed, optional SDK case skipped. Includes missing private bank, missing team bank, partial response, revoked grants and provenance validation.
20 adapter contract and 47 memory tests passed against synthetic fixtures.
13 review tests and seven deletion lifecycle integration tests passed. Optional database cases skipped.

limitations: Live backend cancellation semantics were not exercised. Safe deletion relies on the adapter reporting cancelled only once that attempt can no longer write.
No disposable PostgreSQL server or official Hindsight SDK used locally. Review scope is the changed shared-memory paths.
